g.text: UK National Curriculum & MTC Standard • 1 to 12 Multiplication Format & 12×12 Grid
Seven multiplied by eight equals fifty-six
Decompose difficult multipliers into friendly 5s and 2s!
Formed when a number is multiplied by itself
(n × n = n² along the main diagonal).
Select the correct product to score!
Standard School Times Table: 7 × 8 = 56 • 8 groups of 7 • Inverse: 56 ÷ 7 = 8.
